methodology: Exact Git added-line sets between frozen commits. Python AST excludes imports, dataclass/schema fields, top-level constants, docstrings, comments and blanks. TypeScript compiler AST separates declarations, JSX/static presentation and executable UI behavior. Tests, docs, generated/data, typed wire/API composition, package exports, formal-run/ledger/audit scripts and vendor/source-pool content receive zero production credit. Effective production is the durable experiment/workload/metric/statistics/requirement/report/bundle/portfolio runtime plus non-JSX experiment workbench behavior.
